Guidance & outlook: Coming to our financial performance for Q1 FY27, we have started the year on a strong note, with revenue from operations at IINR424 crores, growing 55% year-on-year from INR273 crores in Q1 FY26.

While PAT increased to INR43 crores in Q1 FY27 from INR22 crores from Q1 FY26, showing increase of 100% year -on-year and 36% quarter -on-quarter, with PAT margin improving by 230 basis points year-on-year and 385 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
Gross margin have expanded from 3.9% in FY23 to 11.1% in FY26.
Growth & demand: We have also seen a steady shift towards our corporate customers over the years, with the contribution to revenue increasing from 55% in financial year '24 to 64% in financial year '26, highlighting the growth, growing depth and strength of our relationshi p with established jewellery players.
So, I wanted to understand, in Q1 FY27, we had a Y -o-Y growth of 55%.
So, you can say the volume growth is consistent, and the growth of sales is because of the better customer relationship, and actually we have grown the growth from Q1 FY26 to Q1 FY27.
Margins & costs: EBITDA stood at INR61 crores, increasing 92% year-on-year and 30% quarter-on-quarter, with EBITDA margin improving by 279 basis points year -on-year and 504 basis points quarter -on- quarter.
At the same time, EBITDA margin have expanded from 2.5% in financial year '23 to 9.7% in financial year '26, while PAT margin have improved from 1.1% to 6.5%.
Even most of them don't have EBITDA margin of 10%.
Capex & expansion: Importantly, profitability remained strong, with gross profit at INR66 crores, up by 95% year - on-year and 7% quarter-on-quarter, accompanied by gross margin expansion of 323 basis points year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter, respectively.
The expansion in margins and operating leverage demonstrates the scalability of our platform as we continue to deepen customer relationships and grow the business.
I am comparing with only gold jewellery company, and none of them have seen this kind of margin expansion.
Balance sheet & cash: At the same time, our debt-to-equity ratio has improved significantly from 2.1x in financial year '23 to 0.8x in financial year '26.
Basically, if you will see the cash flow margin, cash flow operating margin is -- because we don't have the long-term funding.
And you don't have a long-term debt, you only have a short-term debt.
